breakdown.summary: A 33-second concept promo for a visual-search app ('Cosmos'), built entirely as motion graphics: kinetic type, a logo that builds from dots, and a mocked-up product UI being used by a hand cursor. It sells the idea by showing the product working (search by image, by colour, by category) instead of telling it. Everything is flat 2D on two pages - near-black and off-white - with the colour coming only from the content (posters, the rainbow ring, the picker, the sky). The whole piece is rendered at 18 fps in a 30 fps file, which gives it a stepped, hand-made rhythm.
breakdown.hook: f0-60 (00:00:00:00-00:00:02:00): a light-grey page and a question typed word by word - 'Are you' (f4-10), 'lost' on the beat at f21 (00:00:00:21), 'finding' f33, 'inspirations' f38 - in small thin type. It stops the scroll by naming a feeling the target viewer (designers looking for references) has, with nothing else on screen; the hard cut on the beat at f61 (00:00:02:01) to black and a single white dot promises the answer.
structure: f0-60 (00:00:00:00-00:00:02:00) hook: the question in kinetic type on light grey
f61-143 (00:00:02:01-00:00:04:23) brand reveal: a dot orbits into the Cosmos logo (f79-100), shrinks into the lockup, tagline 'Cosmos finds you' word by word on the beats

f144-355 (00:00:04:24-00:00:11:25) feature 1 - search by image: logo morphs into the search bar, cursor clicks the camera icon, a poster is dragged in, results grid fades up on the first drop (f298, 00:00:09:28)

f356-610 (00:00:11:26-00:00:20:10) feature 2 - search by colour: 'Inspiration in every shade', the rainbow ring flies into the bar, the page shrinks onto a sky photo, the colour picker sweeps the hues, blue results scroll in
f611-750 (00:00:20:11-00:00:25:00) feature 3 - categories: light page, 'Cinematography / Graphic design / Moodboard' carousel with an image row per category
f751-825 (00:00:25:01-00:00:27:15) payoff on the second drop (f745, 00:00:24:25): an S-shaped ribbon of dozens of images, 'Seprates scene from' then 'Scrolling'
f826-937 (00:00:27:16-00:00:31:07) end lockup: smoke to white, the logo rebuilds dot by dot, 'Cosmos' types in letter by letter
f938-984 (00:00:31:08-00:00:32:24) credit card 'A concept by afroz'
breakdown.captions: No captions and no voice - the words ARE the graphics. One type style throughout: a thin-to-regular geometric sans (Inter / SF Pro-like), small (about 3 % of the frame height for the lines, 8 % for the end wordmark), centred or left at ~30 %. Words arrive one at a time: each fades up from grey over 3-4 frames with a few pixels of rise, the line re-centres as it grows; 1-3 words per line, 2-4 words per idea.
text_graphics: Logo: a white (later black) disc with a ring of 6-7 dots; built by dots orbiting into it f79-100 and again dot by dot f829-840

UI mock-ups: rounded dark search bar with 'Search Cosmos...' placeholder, camera icon and the rainbow dot ring; drop-zone panel with dashed border; colour picker with hue slider and hex chip; results grids of posters
A hand cursor performs every action (click, drag, press 'Search')
Category list with the active line in black and the others grey
The S ribbon of tilted image cards (f751-825)
Credit card: round avatar + 'A concept by afroz'
breakdown.broll: No footage. The 'b-roll' is curated imagery inside the UI - posters, film stills, design boards - shown as search results, which proves the product's point (it finds visual inspiration). Only one photographic background: the blue sky behind the shrinking UI card (f437-610).
breakdown.sound: Music only (no speech; the transcript is empty), 106.6 BPM. Two measured drops: f298 (00:00:09:28) lands on the panel collapsing and the first results appearing, f745 (00:00:24:25) leads the cut to the S ribbon by 6 frames (f751). A build rises over f670-745. Many word arrivals sit on beats (f21, f38, f116, f128, f883). No clear sound effects measured.
breakdown.cta: No spoken or written CTA - the end lockup (logo + 'Cosmos', f900-937) works as the brand sign-off, and the credit 'A concept by afroz' (f938-984) points to the creator.
transitions: Shape morph: the logo disc stretches into the search bar (f146-172, E015)
Element hand-off: the rainbow ring flies into the bar and becomes its icon (f399-410, E025)
Scale-down reveal: the dark UI page shrinks into a card over a sky photo (f437-471, E031)
Collapse + staggered fade-up: the panel shrinks into the bar on the drop and the results fade up row by row (f293-311, E023)
Line scroll: the category list scrolls one line while image rows close upward and new ones open from a line (f651-719, E041)
White smoke wipe to the end card (f819-826, E044)
breakdown.camera: No real camera. A virtual camera in 2D only: the whole UI scales down to keep a growing panel in frame and pushes back in (f213-227, E017), slow push-ins on resting grids (f590-610, f720-750), and the page-to-card scale (E031). No parallax, no 3D, no shake (the two 'shakes' were layout slides).
breakdown.grade: Not a grade - a design palette. Measured: two pages, near-black #171518 (41 % of the pixels) and off-white #F2F0F3 (43 %), saturation 13 %. The colour.py words 'desaturated, low contrast, lifted blacks' describe the flat UI greys, not a look applied to footage. Colour comes only from content: the posters, the rainbow ring, the red-to-blue picker, the blue sky (#366BB4), the blue-toned results. Rebuild it with these hex values rather than a LUT.
breakdown.rhythm: 12.8 cuts/min (the scenes change rarely; the motion inside them does the work), 33 % of cuts on the beat. Everything moves at 18 fps (3 new frames per 5) - the measured 40-41 % repeated frames in every moving stretch - which reads as crisp, stepped, 'designed' motion. Inside scenes the pattern is: element arrives (3-5 frames, ease-out) > rest of 5-15 frames > next element on the next beat. Holds of 10-30 frames let each feature read.
rebuild_tips: Write the story as a product demo: question hook (3 words + 1), logo, then 3 features each shown being used by a cursor, payoff on the drop, end lockup + credit. Keep it at 30-35 s.
Use two pages only (#171518 dark, #F2F0F3 light) and one thin geometric sans; let your content/images bring all the colour.
Animate every word and element with the same move: opacity from grey + 4-12 px rise over 3-5 frames, ease-out, staggered 1-2 frames - then hold 10-15 frames.
Render the motion at 18 fps inside a 30 fps timeline (nearest-frame conform, no frame blending) for the stepped look.

Connect scenes by turning one element into the next (logo > search bar, ring > icon, page > card) instead of transitions; put plain hard cuts on beats and the biggest visual (the image ribbon) on the drop.
Copy the structure and the motion language, not the brand: make your own logo, UI and images (HyperFrames in the lab can build the UI and the type).
